name: mcp-search-console
description: Query Google Search Console from Claude: search analytics, URL inspection, indexing audits and sitemaps.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to Google Search Console. Query clicks, impressions, CTR and positions with filters and period comparisons, inspect URLs and audit indexing in batches, and manage sitemaps. Sign in with a service account key, or with an OAuth client file: the first OAuth use opens a browser window for Google login and the token is kept in your user config folder. Adding or deleting properties and sitemaps stays disabled unless you enable it.

credentials_path.title: Service account key
credentials_path.description: JSON key of a Google service account that has access to your Search Console properties. Use this or an OAuth client file.

oauth_client_secrets_file.title: OAuth client file
oauth_client_secrets_file.description: client_secrets.json of a Google OAuth desktop client. The first use opens a browser window to sign in. Use this or a service account key.

data_state.title: Data state
data_state.description: all matches the Search Console dashboard (includes fresh data); final returns only confirmed data, 2-3 days behind.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get a full list of all available tools, current auth status, and how to get started.

tools.name: list_properties

tools.name: batch_url_inspection

tools.name: check_indexing_issues

tools.name: get_performance_overview

tools.name: get_advanced_search_analytics

tools.name: compare_search_periods

tools.description: List all sitemaps for a specific Search Console property with detailed information.
